svg.text: GOVERNANCE — transversal, applies across Data and AI / BI / ML alike
incl. AI Gateway usage controls: per-model rate limits + per-tenant monthly budgets (live)
AI / BI / ML — consumption: one Deployment per scenario kind
DATA — generation: k8s Jobs, run once or on demand
Routes every LLM call — rate limits,
Document Q&A over a scenario's knowledge
Voice mode — STT/TTS bridge into the 3
GenAI monitor — a trace per LLM call,
Langfuse's trace store — the only store
Runs identically on Kubernetes (k3s), namespace ai-circus, and via docker compose — solid arrows: primary request/data paths; dotted: cross-cutting auth/admin/monitoring calls

Admin-only monitors: Langfuse (langfuse.localhost) and MLflow (mlflow.localhost) reuse Postgres/Valkey/SeaweedFS — see architecture-data-platform.svg for the optional Data Platform profile (Kafka, CDC, lakehouse, semantic layer)
